symbols.name: GetValue(IResult)
symbols.summary: Retrieves the value contained in the given BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.Result instance.

syntax.content: public static object GetValue(this IResult source)

parameters.description: The source BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.Result instance from which the value is to be retrieved.

returns.description: The value contained in the given BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.Result instance if it is of type BridgingIT.DevKit.Domain.DomainPolicyResult%601 or BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.Result%601; otherwise, returns the default value for the type.
